validation_vs_verification.validation_question: Do the claims survive matched deploy-metric tests?
validation_vs_verification.verification_handoff: Run the independent invariant checks and record immutable artifacts.

claims.claim: The feature-only repair improves the fixed official evaluation set.

tests.threat: Package lineage or evaluation version changes.
tests.design: Compare immutable VTREPLAY with the scored 33.85 package; only features change.
tests.independence: Same evaluation version; no tuning after feedback; independent checks before submission.
tests.acceptance: Report S(V)-S(B); recovery and practical improvement are separate.
tests.threshold_basis: Historical 33.85 and 34.73 anchors; 0.50 raw-point practical gate is a design choice.
tests.failure_action: If versions or lineage differ, mark unresolved; do not attribute the score change to A0.

claims.claim: Pooled expected-F improves deployment F over a matched MSE control.

tests.threat: Development reuse, source correlation, and seed selection.
tests.design: Freeze all paired candidates before one evaluation on 500 fresh source-disjoint sources; retain natural prevalence.
tests.independence: Independent confirmation sources and near-duplicate clusters excluded from training and model selection.
tests.baseline: Matched MSE, plus a preregistered soft-F diagnostic
tests.acceptance: Mean paired improvement >=0.007 and cluster CI lower bound >0; all seeds reported.
tests.threshold_basis: 0.007 is the predeclared minimum useful temporal effect; no platform-score conversion is assumed.
tests.failure_action: Use INCONCLUSIVE for wide CI; scope-specific NO_PRACTICAL_GAIN only when upper CI <0.007.

claims.claim: Native training and evaluation use the same valid reward units.

tests.threat: Native slot-count denominator mixed with original-frame gains.
tests.design: Verify reward range, duplication invariance, unit scaling, and small exact enumeration; compare training/export actions.
tests.independence: Independent brute-force verifier on synthetic cases, then held-out raw-frame replay.
tests.acceptance: Reward within [0,1], matched integer counts, enumeration errors <=1e-10 in FP64.
tests.failure_action: Mark INVALID_IMPLEMENTATION; invalidate affected claims, not unrelated pooled experiments.

claims.claim: The native feature path reads the intended normalized frames.

tests.threat: Seek units, preprocessing, stale cache, and hidden filtering.
tests.design: Check actual PTS and frame IDs against sequential decode; compare processor inputs with official checkpoint transform.
tests.independence: Independent decoder and frozen manifest; no selection by GT or observed improvement.
tests.baseline: Sequential original-frame decoding and official transform
tests.metric: frame identity and input tensor agreement
tests.acceptance: Exact frame identities under frozen nearest-frame policy; declared input tolerance met; cache hash matches.
tests.threshold_basis: Input contract and source-video timing semantics.
tests.failure_action: Quarantine affected caches; rebuild under a new contract hash before training.

claims.claim: Ordered input provides deployment benefit beyond static multi-frame content.

tests.threat: Repeated-middle control also removes static visual coverage.
tests.design: Compare ordered, shuffled, and a static multi-frame aggregation control with matched training budget.
tests.independence: Independent source-disjoint holdout for confirmation; exposed development data only for choosing variants, never training on heldout sources.
tests.baseline: Static multi-frame content control, not only repeated middle frame
tests.acceptance: Paired useful F improvement and documented control parity; AP alone cannot pass.
tests.threshold_basis: Same practical effect gate and valid action/feature contract.
tests.failure_action: Retain as engineering asset; do not claim motion caused an AP difference.

claims.claim: A budget-matched objective improves the hard deployment cut.

tests.threat: Unconstrained action expectation mismatches deterministic top-K.
tests.design: Compare MSE, unrestricted expected F, and budget-conditioned expected F with identical exporter.
tests.independence: All variants developed on exposed dev; test once after freezing on a separately preregistered confirmation set.
tests.acceptance: Useful paired hard-mask gain; oracle headroom and exchange mass reported.
tests.threshold_basis: Budget-matched mathematical objective; empirical improvement still requires confirmation.
tests.failure_action: Pause only this budget/decoder scope if its useful headroom or measured upper CI is below threshold.

correction_promotion_tests: Verify reward and feature corrections independently before promotion.
cross_stage_tests: Use the same actual frame exporter for train diagnostics, validation, and package.
